scores.tell: Barely any. The calculator is tilted, soft-matte and smoothly 3D on a quiet pi pattern, the same look as the real towel and whistle cards. The body is maybe slightly pillowy.

It is close to the real swing card's painted garden style. The background is a little busy (two trees, a path, hedges, a lot of grass tufts), and the muted lilac stone table is flatter and duller than the bold heroes on the real cards. Its thin dark edge lines are a little crisp.

The coffin is a flat, front-on, symmetric hexagon slab with almost no top face. It has a hard white streak on the top-left edge and banded, plasticky orange-red shading. It looks pasted onto a generic lawn. Real cards tilt the hero and turn its form softly.
